translations.web: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.
translations.bsb: As you watched, a stone was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay, and crushed them.
translations.kjv: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
